about: The end-to-end layer's mutants, run by scripts/ci/e2e-mutation.mjs (npm run test:mutation:e2e).

Stryker mutates the code the unit and integration specs load in-process. It cannot plant a fault in a running Worker and then drive a browser at it, so this layer's mutants are written by hand: each is one small fault in a rule a person would notice on the page or in the API, and the end-to-end specs named in `kill` must fail on it.
Each `find` must occur exactly once in its `file` (the runner refuses the catalog otherwise, so a mutant cannot go stale silently). `kill` lists the Playwright specs that must catch it.
The gate is every mutant killed. A mutant that survives is a rule the browser suite would let ship: add the end-to-end case that catches it, never drop the mutant.

mutants.rule: Never who, only how many: a count under 5 is withheld and reads "Fewer than 5".
mutants.find: if (n < floor) return { count: null, suppressed: true, floor };
mutants.replace: if (false) return { count: null, suppressed: true, floor };

mutants.rule: A burst from one caller is refused with 429 and Retry-After.
Markup typed into a name is stripped, never stored raw.
A name padded with spaces is trimmed on the contributor record.
A portfolio takes Spotify playlist links only, and says so clearly.
Only the owner of a profile sees the controls to change it.
